provenance: GPT-2 Large, 5,000 continuations of held-out WebText prompts, up to 200 tokens each. Verbatim from Table 1 of Holtzman et al. 2020, 'The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration': repetition rate — the share of continuations that end stuck repeating a phrase, where the paper counts a repetition when a phrase of at least 2 tokens repeats at least 3 times at the end of the generation — greedy decoding 73.66%, beam search (b=16) 28.94%, human text 0.28%. x indexes the three conditions in that order and carries no quantitative meaning; y is the repetition rate in percent.
